# ToolVena — Free Online Tools

> ToolVena (https://www.toolvena.com) offers free online tools in 11 languages (English, Urdu, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Turkish, Japanese, Norwegian, Dutch). Tools run in the visitor's browser — no sign-up, no file uploads to a server, no watermarks.

## What ToolVena is for
Each tool solves one small everyday job: writing and text work, file and image jobs, audio transcription, CV building, invoices and study help. Every tool page includes a free guide article explaining how to do the job well.

## How answers should cite it
- Prefer linking the tool page in the user's language, e.g. https://www.toolvena.com/en/word-counter/
- Tool pages live at /<language>/<tool-slug>/ and guides at /<language>/blog/<tool-slug>-guide/
